visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Macro view of a rough, golden-yellow crystal cluster sitting on a small silver metal stand against a deep black background. Large bold yellow text overlays are positioned at the top and bottom of the frame, providing static context about the mineral specimen. (2) The camera zooms in closely on the crystalline facets of the fluorite, which appear translucent and honey-like under bright studio lighting. The fine geometric edges of the individual cubes are clearly visible, showcasing their intricate physical structure and texture. (3) The lighting switches from natural visible light to an ultraviolet source. The crystal suddenly transforms, emitting a vibrant purple and blue glow with shimmering golden inner highlights. The dark environment makes the fluorescent colors appear extremely vivid and high-contrast on screen. (4) Extreme close-up shots reveal horizontal internal banding of purple and gold within the translucent crystalline cubes as the camera pans slowly. Small dark specks or inclusions are visible deep within the structure, highlighting the complex natural growth layers of the stone. (5) The final shot pulls back to show the full crystal cluster glowing under the UV lamp. The yellow variety show-style text remains consistent. The video ends with a smooth fade to black, completing the visual presentation of the mineral's unique properties.
